context.person: A person using a learning management system
context.user_goal: Upload the video again before submission or continue editing the draft.

product_state.preceding_state: The browser lost its connection while a student was attaching a video to an assignment.
product_state.current_state: The written response was saved. The video upload did not complete.
known_facts: The video upload did not complete.
The video can be selected again or the draft can be reopened without it.
forbidden_claims: The service can recover the local video automatically.

challenge: Rewrite the decision or recovery dialog so the person can understand assignment upload incomplete, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Open the file picker and select the video again.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Return to the saved assignment draft.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The assignment remains unsubmitted without the required video.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Upload the video again before submission or continue editing the draft.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
